description: List the upstream bug/idea reports YOU filed to the PAPI maintainers (via the `bug` tool with report=true or an auto-routed PAPI bug), newest first. Read-only. Shows each report's id, kind (bug/idea), triage status, description, and when it was filed. Scoped to your own submissions only — never another user's. Requires a database adapter (pg or hosted proxy); the local md adapter has no upstream store. Does not call the Anthropic API.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of reports to return. Omit to return all. Reserved for future pagination — current behaviour returns all your reports newest-first regardless of value.

name: bug_list
